description: Colorado civic discovery anchors. Each anchor points to legal jurisdictions and authoritative institutional information; physical sites do not define the full legal jurisdiction.

anchors.name: Colorado State Capitol
anchors.notes: Colorado's legislative and executive civic anchor. Visitor policies are separate from statewide statutes and regulations.

anchors.name: Ralph L. Carr Colorado Judicial Center
anchors.notes: Judicial anchor for the Colorado Supreme Court and Colorado Court of Appeals. Public access to oral arguments and current court schedules must be checked with the Judicial Branch.

anchors.name: Denver City and County Building
anchors.notes: Municipal civic anchor housing the Mayor's Office, City Council chambers, courtrooms, and other city offices. The Denver municipal jurisdiction record must be maintained separately from this site.

anchors.name: Colorado Secretary of State Office
anchors.notes: The Colorado State Capitol visitor guide identifies the Secretary of State's office at 1700 Broadway. The Secretary of State's official business filing form gives the office address as 1700 Broadway, Suite 550. Verify office access and services before visiting.

next_colorado_candidates: Colorado Attorney General / Department of Law (already associated with the Ralph L. Carr Judicial Center)
expansion_policy.rule: Add an anchor only with an authoritative site source and explicit jurisdiction references. Do not infer legal applicability from proximity.
